name: John Napier
summary: Scottish mathematician, physicist, and astronomer known for inventing logarithms and calculating rods.

name: Archibald Napier
summary: Father of John Napier and Seventh Laird of Merchiston.

name: Janet Bothwell
summary: Mother of John Napier.

name: Elizabeth Stirling
summary: First wife of John Napier.

name: Agnes Chisholm
summary: Second wife of John Napier.

name: Archibald Napier
summary: Son of John Napier and co-author of salt distribution instructions.

name: Jane Napier
summary: Daughter of John Napier and Elizabeth Stirling.

name: Robert Napier
summary: Son of John Napier who published Constructio.

name: Merchiston Castle
summary: Medieval tower house in Edinburgh where John Napier was born.

name: University of St Andrews
summary: Scottish university where John Napier enrolled in 1563.

name: St Salvator's College
summary: College within the University of St Andrews where John Napier studied.

name: Gartness
summary: Estate in Stirlingshire where John Napier lived with his first wife.

name: St Cuthbert's Church
summary: Parish church in Edinburgh where John Napier served as an Elder.

name: St Giles
summary: Church in Edinburgh where some Napier family members are buried.

name: Mirifici Logarithmorum Canonis Descriptio
summary: 1614 publication by John Napier introducing logarithmic tables.

name: Rabdologiae
summary: 1617 publication by John Napier introducing calculating rods and devices.

name: Napier's Bones
summary: Calculating device using rods with multiples organized in diagonal segments.

name: Promptuary
summary: Calculating device using strips with apertures to mask values.

name: Local Arithmetic
summary: Method of calculating using counters on a chess board.

name: Plaine Discovery of the Whole Revelation of St John
summary: 1593 theological publication by John Napier on religious apocalypse.

name: Constructio
summary: 1619 publication of Napier's logarithmic methodology published by Robert Napier.

name: De Arte Logistica
summary: Collection of Napier's mathematical notes published in 1839.

name: Henry Briggs
summary: Professor of Mathematics at Gresham College who collaborated with Napier on logarithms.

name: Johannes Kepler
summary: Imperial Mathematician who used Napier's logarithms for the Rudolphine Tables.

name: Edinburgh Napier University
summary: University in Edinburgh named after John Napier.

name: Merchiston Campus
summary: Campus of Edinburgh Napier University incorporating Merchiston Tower.

name: King James VI
summary: King of Scotland who granted patents to the Napier family.
